title: Samsung announces a $200B+ contract to make chips for Broadcom through 2030, focusing on its 2nm and below process technologies for Broadcom's products (Hooyeon Kim/Bloomberg)
commentary: $200B through 2030 is Samsung's biggest foundry bet yet — and a direct challenge to TSMC's AI-era dominance. Broadcom picking Samsung for 2nm-and-below signals the custom AI chip race is creating enough demand for two serious fabs.
